sentences.text: The applicant has filed this First bail application under Section 482 of BNSS/438 of Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail.

2. Applicant apprehends his arrest in connection with Crime No.199 of 2025 registered at Police Station Vishwavidyalay, District Gwalior (M.P.) in relation to the offence punishable under Sections 420, 120(B) of IPC.

3. As per prosecution story, the incident alleged is that a registered sale deed was executed by one Natthu, s/o late Shri Dharmpal; Makkho, d/o late Shri Dharmpal and Makhaniya, w/o of late Shri Dharmpal, in favour of Suresh Kumar, r/o Gwalior, who was authorized by Krishna Landcon Private Limited, and the same is reflected in the revenue records.
The said sale deed was executed on 27.09.2023 in the office of the Sub-Registrar.

This clearly establishes that Krishna Landcon Private Limited, in collusion with Mr. Suresh Kumar, the witnesses, and the Sub-Registrar, Gwalior entered into a criminal, pre-planned conspiracy and caused the execution of the sale deed in NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:342 2 MCRC-58285-2025 respect of the above-mentioned land.

For the purpose of getting the said sale deed executed, forged documents were prepared and other persons were falsely produced, and the sale deed of the complainant's land was got executed in a Krishna Landcon Pvt. sentences.text:
In this regard, upon the direction of the Trial Court under under Section 156(3) of Cr.P.C., the Police Station Vishwavidyalay was directed to register an FIR, and accordingly on 14.06.2025 crime No.199/2025 was registered for the offence as aforesaid.
4.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is further submitted that it is purely a civil dispute between the parties.
The allegations made by the complainant against the applicant are based on incorrect facts.

In reality, the applicant got the sale deed of the aforesaid land executed through property brokers namely Lokendra Jatav, Ajay Jatav, Manish Jatav, Sonu Jatav, Vinod Jatav, who, as per their representations, dealt with the landowners.
The applicant paid the actual consideration amount through banking channels and got the sale deed executed from the persons presented as landowners.
In relation to the fraud committed against the applicant, the applicant had submitted a written complaint against the aforesaid brokers before the Superintendent of Police, Gwalior.

The applicant, acting in good faith, relied upon the persons and documents presented by the brokers and, treating them as the true owners of the property on the basis of their Aadhaar NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:342 3 MCRC-58285-2025 cards and land documents, paid the genuine consideration amount and got the sale deed of the said land executed.
The applicant has not committed any fraud against any person, nor has the applicant intentionally committed any offence.
It is further submitted that if he is arrested by the police, his reputation in society will be permanently tarnished.
There is no likelihood of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
Applicant undertakes to cooperate in investigation/trial.
The applicant is ready to abide by all the terms and condition as imposed by this Court.
Under these grounds, learned counsel prayed for anticipatory bail.
5. Learned counsel for the respondent/State has vehemently opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of the application.

6. Heard the counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
7.

Considering the above submissions and facts situation of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court intends to allow the application, therefore, it is hereby directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand Only) with two solvent sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of Arresting Authority/Investigating Officer.

8. This order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following conditions by the applicant:-
(1).

The applicant will comply with all the terms and conditions of the bond executed by him;
